Zone is one of the most basic elements of [[Numogram]]. At its most basic, it is simply a decimal digit. Digits are almost like numbers, but not the same (see discussion at [[Numeric and numerical]]) - they have additional intricacies with respect to radix, and they are scale-indifferent—i.e. a given digit, e.g. 9, can refer to numbers 9, 90, 900, etc; depending on its context (position). Mathematically, a zone is almost like a member of ''the ring of integers modulo 9''. Almost - because in the ring, there is no member 9, only 0; or we can say, 0 and 9 are the same; while among the zones, 0 and 9 are equal but not exactly the same. While from [[Architectonic Order of the Eschaton (AOE)|AOE]] perspective, digits can be conceptualized as precise points, lemurian zones are loose, nebulous and diffuse in themselves:
''With Stillwell's epoch-switching discovery of the Numogram - and subsequent mapping of this 'digital labyrinth' - it became possible to compile cartographies of these zones, in which numbers distribute themselves throughout tropics, clusters, and regions. The zones thus function as diagrammatic components of flat cosmic maps (variously charting systems of coincidence, nebular circulations, spinal nestings, and the folds of inner/outer time).''[http://www.ccru.net/zones/Zn.htm The Zones]
Also from lemurian perspective, zones are secondary in genesis to [[Demon|demons]] and, in a way, do not exist at all:
''Obviously the AOE is into the Stillwell numogram and the whole Syzygy system, but they cannot see it for what it is, which is slightly wrong, because it isn’t anything, it’s a [[becoming]], but they see it in a systematically distorted way. One key issue here comes out of this Deleuze quote where he says Gods aren’t the same as demons. Gods have fixed attributes and territories, whereas demons are more or less to do with intensities. There is all sorts of implications of this – the zones in the numogram, from the point of view of Lemurian time sorcery, or what everything on the schizo side is immersed in, the zones don’t exist in a way, which is to say that they are not becomings. [...] So you treat the 1 and the 8 as unified rather than singular. So at every level you are just atomizing things, so you are seeing 1:8 as a meta-entity, and you are seeing 1 and 8 as meta-entities. But obviously the way Lemurian Time Sorcery sees it is, no that’s not right, you can always subtract that, multiplicity composed of forces in tension. Zones are just tension-accumulation zones. [...] the zones emerge out of tensions between the demons.''[https://sonicwarfare.wordpress.com/2023/01/13/ccru-syzygy-conversation-between-mark-fisher-steve-goodman-24-11-98/ Syzygy Conversation between Mark Fisher & Steve Goodman 24/11/98]
''Zones form the surface level of the numogram: the [[Net]].''[http://www.ccru.net/id(entity)/glossary.htm CCRU Glossary]
